title: Chat together
summary: Invite people into a chat and work with the same AI together, plus steadier terminals and chat history.

highlights.title: Shared chats
highlights.body: Invite collaborators into a chat. Everyone sees the same conversation, messages show who wrote them, and the AI keeps working for the whole group.

items.text: Terminals start, scroll and keep their session controls reliably.
Chat history keeps its titles while you scroll, and unread rows stay in place.
The Dock badge in the desktop app matches your unread chats.
Deleting a project also removes its chats and terminal sessions.
